summary: Iter131 (SA CoParents): Full test of Court Codes + Align progress endpoint + joint-case requested_progress + weekly requested reminders. Backend: 11/11 new tests in tests/test_iter131_court_codes.py + 3/3 existing tests/test_requested_reminders.py = 14/14 pass. Frontend: Court Codes panel on /professional/joint-alignment/mine fully functional — list, create (7 checkboxes, disabled-until-picked, label, days select), parent note includes SAC-code + 'Accept Your Court-Ordered Invite', copy/done, waiting state, revoke flips state to 'Revoked'. CC-P445YM shows Avery Q Codeparent with coparent/self/medical all 'Not started'. SA-DEMO01 pj-mine-progress rows show 'Requested · 1 of 1 done' and 'Co-Parenting Assessment Done · Oct 7, 2026'. Mobile 390px: no horizontal overflow. UI contains zero 'answer'/'score' word hits anywhere. Align integration doc /app/memory/ALIGN_COURT_CODES_SETUP.md matches API behaviour and never prints the secret. Cron/Monday gate code inspection OK: /app/.emergent/crons.yml sa-reassess-reminder runs daily 09:00 America/Chicago; cron_routes.py line 139–140 gates send_requested_reminders on weekday()==0.

issues: Dev-only React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' originates from the visual-editor instrumentation wrapping dynamic text of each <option value={d}>{d} days</option> in CourtCodeForm.jsx line 66 with a style:contents <span>. Harmless in production builds (no visual breakage, dropdown works), but noisy. If you want it clean, render the number as a plain string outside any wrapper (e.g. `{`${d} days`}`) so the instrumentation does not inject a <span> inside <option>.

action_items: (Optional, low priority) Silence the <option>/<span> hydration warning in CourtCodeForm.jsx by rendering option text as a non-wrapped expression.
critical_code_review_comments: court_codes_routes.create_court_code: generates `code` and only stores `_hash_key(code)` — raw code never persisted. Returned once in response. Correct.

court_codes_routes.linked_parents + court_checklist.progress_rows: assessments returned only carry `key, title, status (done|in_progress|todo), finished_at`. Verified via Playwright scrape — no 'answer'/'score' words appear on the professional UI.

integration_routes.court_key_progress: filters `created_by: {$exists: False}` so in-app court codes correctly return 404 via Align — verified by backend test test_inapp_code_returns_404_via_integration.

requested_reminders.send_requested_reminders: skip order (reminders_off → already_sent → all_done → safety → no_email) is correct; the dedupe write happens AFTER status checks so an all-done or safety-flagged user is never recorded in requested_reminder_sends. Clean.
cron_routes.py:140 uses `datetime.now(ZoneInfo('America/Chicago')).weekday() == 0` — correct Monday gate; combined with daily 9am Chicago cron this yields exactly Mondays 9am CT.

ALIGN_COURT_CODES_SETUP.md: no secret value baked in — only placeholder `<INTEGRATION_SHARED_SECRET>`; endpoints and keys match implementation (coparent/self/educational/medical/psychological/foundation/parallel) exactly.

Minor: integration_routes.CourtKeyUpsert.requested uses `Literal[...]` directly — unknown keys 422 ✔. However requested is `default_factory=list` meaning Align can upsert without any requested — intentional per spec; just worth noting an empty-requested Align code would never trigger weekly reminders for its linked parents, which matches the 'covers every requested item unless finished' rule.
